data.name: Hisyam
data.gender_notes: Hisyam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hisyam is derived from the Arabic word ‘hisan’, meaning ‘gift’, ‘grace’, or ‘blessing’. It is mentioned in the Hadith that Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) named his grandson Hisyam due to his being a blessing and a gift to the Prophet and his family. Hisyam is a name that signifies the blessings and grace of Allah. The name Hisyam carries the meaning “Gift, Grace, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hisyam usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's blessings in our lives.
data.etymology: Hisyam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hisyam total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: حسيام
in_arabic.meaning: حسيام تعني الحسم و القطع و السرعة في العمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسيام هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الحسم و القطع و السرعة في العمل. و يدل على الشخص الذي يتميز بالحسم و القرار السريع و التنفيذ الفوري. و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الإرادة.

in_urdu.name: حسیام
in_urdu.meaning: حسیام مطلب ہے فیصلہ کرنے کی جلدی اور کام کرنے کی سرعت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسیام ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے فیصلہ کرنے کی جلدی اور کام کرنے کی سرعت۔ یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو فیصلے کرنے میں جلدی اور کام کو جلدی سے مکمل کرنے کی خصوصیت رکھتی ہیں۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان اقدار کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو مسلمانوں کے دৈنیہ زندگی میں اہم ہیں، جیسے کہ فیصلے کی سرعت اور کام کی سعادت۔

in_hindi.name: हिसयाम
in_hindi.meaning: हिसयाम का अर्थ है निर्णय लेने की जल्दी और काम करने की गति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिसयाम एक मस्कुलिन नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है। इसका अर्थ है निर्णय लेने की जल्दी और काम करने की गति। यह नाम उन व्यक्तित्वों को संबोधित करता है जो निर्णय लेने में जल्दी और काम को जल्दी से पूरा करने की विशेषता रखते हैं। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन मूल्यों को दर्शाता है जो मुसलमानों के दैनिक जीवन में महत्वपूर्ण हैं, जैसे कि निर्णय की गति और काम की सादगी।

in_pashto.name: حسيام
in_pashto.meaning: حسيام د فیصلې کولو چټکتیا او د کار د سرعت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسيام یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د فیصلې کولو چټکتیا او د کار د سرعت معنی لري. دا نوم هغه شخصیتونو ته خطاب کوي چی په فیصلې کولو کې چټکتیا او کار په چټکۍ سره بشپړولو کی ځانګړتیا لري. په اسلامي دودیزو کې، دا نوم هغه ارزښتونه ښیي چی د مسلمانانو په ورځني ژوند کې مهم دي، لکه د فیصلې سرعت او د کار سعادت.

in_english.name: Hisyam
in_english.meaning: Hisyam means decisiveness and speed in action or implementation
in_english.long_meaning: Hisyam is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It signifies decisiveness and speed in action or implementation. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-s-y' which relates to haste, speed, and decisiveness. In Islamic tradition, the name Hisyam embodies qualities valued in Muslim daily life, such as swift decision-making and efficient execution. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the importance of prompt action and determination.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Futuh Misr (The Conquest of Egypt), chapter 28: 'The Conquest of Alexandria'. Hisyam b. Ghusn was the last Umayyad governor of Egypt before the Abbasids took control.
historical_references.context: The Umayyad Caliph Marwan II appointed Hisyam as the governor of Egypt, but the people of Egypt were not satisfied with his rule and his unjust taxation. They rebelled, and Hisyam was forced to leave Egypt. The Abbasids took advantage of this situation and conquered Egypt, marking the end of Umayyad rule in the region.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun, The History of the Berbers, vol. 1, chapter 14: 'The Reign of the Aghlabids'. Hisyam b. Gulgamis was an Aghlabid emir who ruled Tunisia in the mid-9th century AD.
historical_references.context: The Aghlabids were a Berber dynasty that ruled Tunisia and parts of North Africa. Hisyam b. Gulgamis was a notable emir of this dynasty who is known for his military conquests and construction projects. He expanded the Aghlabid dominions in the Maghreb, including the conquest of Sicily, and built many palaces and fortresses.
